text: Campaign mode is similar to a linear first-person shooter game, with secrets and bosses.
Adventure mode is an open-ended game where you can explore dungeons, find new towns, gamble for items, etc.
Hit the keys [c red]ESDF[c white] to move your character.\n\nUse the [c red]mouse[c white] to look around.
Hit [c red]Spacebar[c white] to pickup items.\n\nHit [c red]C[c white] to open your inventory.
To open the door, hit [c red]Spacebar[c white] while facing it.
Use [c red]Mouse button 4[c white] to attack with your melee weapon.
Hit [c red]Spacebar[c white] to activate the switch.
Use [c red]Left-click[c white] to shoot your gun. Hold [c red]right-click[c white] to aim and reduce recoil at the cost of movement speed.
Attack the crate to open it.
Hit [c red]W[c white] to switch weapons.
